name: Projects in Solopreneur
description:
1. Redefined the solopreneur "Project" concept into two plain-language sections (Projects + Sprints) aimed at non-technical managers who only need to review status.
2. Delivered two functional HTML mockups (`solopreneur-projects.html`, `solopreneur-sprints.html`) sharing an approved visual language, with fake API, latency, error and empty states.
3. Implemented both screens in the real app (`SolopreneurProjects.vue`, new `SolopreneurSprints.vue`, new `useSolopreneurProjects.js`) wired to the real `projects`, `kanban` and `chats` stores — tickets being chats, "needs you" being the real `onhold` status.
4. Added paging to the project lists: 4 projects at a time plus a `Load more` button that adds 4 more per click, in both the Projects section and the Summary card.
5. Added a free-text project search that only appears when an account owns more than 4 projects, with an independent query per screen and a page reset on each search.

Let me verify the current state of the files before changing anything.Projects section already has the conditional search. The gap is the **Summary "Your projects" card** (the screen in your screenshots): it pages 4-at-a-time but has no search. Let me confirm the i18n keys.## Review & Understand - Requirement: when an account owns **more than 4** projects, offer a **free-text search** to filter them. - The **Projects section** already has it (`searchableProjects` in the hook + input in `SolopreneurProjects.vue`). - The **Summary → "Your projects" card** (the screen in your screenshots) pages 4-at-a-time but has **no search input** — that's the gap. ## Information gathered | Piece | Current state | |---|---| | `useSolopreneurProjects.js` | `visibleProjects` / `hiddenProjects` / `searchableProjects` / `setQuery` (resets page) — Projects only | | `SolopreneurProjects.vue` | search input rendered only when `searchableProjects`, list uses `visibleProjects` | | `SolopreneurSummary.vue` | `tileLimit` + `visibleTiles` + `hiddenTiles` + `loadMoreTiles` — **no query filter** | | `i18n.js` | `pp.search`, `pp.loadMore`, `pp.showing`, `pp.of`, `pp.noMatch` already present (EN/ES; FR falls back to EN) | ## Change proposal 1. Add a **local** `tileQuery` in `SolopreneurSummary.vue` — deliberately **not** shared with `ui.query`, so typing in the Summary card never silently filters the Projects section (and vice-versa). 2. `filteredTiles` = the tiles matching the query; `visibleTiles` = first `tileLimit` of those; `hiddenTiles` derived from `filteredTiles`. 3. Search input rendered only when the catalogue is `> PROJECTS_PAGE_SIZE` (4) → accounts with ≤4 projects keep the current clean card. 4. Typing/holding a query resets the page to 4 (`filterTiles`), so results are never behind an invisible "Load more". 5. Empty state uses `pp.noMatch` when a query is active, `pr.empty` otherwise; the pager counts against `filteredTiles`. ## Changes summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/solopreneur/SolopreneurSummary.vue` | `tileQuery` + `searchableTiles` / `filteredTiles` + conditional search input, filtered pager and empty state | No new i18n keys, no store changes. ## The change ## Behaviour recap | Situation | Result | |---|---| | ≤ 4 projects | no search input, no pager — card identical to the mockup | | > 4 projects | search input appears (right-aligned, above the tiles), 4 tiles + `Showing 4 of N` / `Load more +4` | | Typing a query | tiles filtered by name, page resets to 4, counter shows the **filtered** total | | Query with no match | `No project matches your search.` (`pp.noMatch`) | | Clearing the query | back to the first page of the full list | | Summary vs Projects | independent queries — typing here does not filter the Projects section |
